title: TSM Career Training Platform
desc: A candidate moves through sector training, a live readiness score, a human HITL approval gate, and into the Earning Path it unlocks.
valueProposition: Not a certificate. A governance trail: training evidence, a live readiness score, and a named manager's approval, before a candidate is deployed.

states.caption: Career Training Platform — 7 sector suites, 6 certification tracks, one readiness-scored pipeline
states.narration: Most staffing firms send a candidate with a resume. This platform sends a candidate with a scored readiness profile, sector tools they already know how to use, and a governance trail proving it.
states.promoCaption: Most staffing firms send a resume. This sends a scored, governed candidate.
states.promoNarration: Most staffing firms send a candidate with a resume. This platform sends a scored readiness profile and a governance trail proving it.

states.caption: Candidate Registry — manager view across every sector [demo environment: no database connected]
states.narration: The Candidate Registry is meant to show every candidate in training, live, to a manager. This sandbox has no database connected, so it shows that plainly instead of faking rows of candidates.

states.caption: Candidate Profile — one record: assigned courses, progress, and what stays locked until approval
states.narration: Every assigned course, every progress checkpoint, and manager feedback live on one candidate record. Employment and deployment stay locked until the HITL approval gate clears.

states.caption: Course Assignment — a manager controls exactly what a candidate can see
states.narration: A manager checks the boxes for the courses a candidate is enrolled in. Uncheck a course and that candidate loses access to it — they never see curriculum they weren't assigned.

states.caption: Healthcare RCM suite — 4 real training tools and a mapped CRCR certification track
states.narration: This is one of seven sector suites. Four tools cover CRCR exam prep, denial scenario practice, HC node navigation, and the live denial war room — mapped to an actual HFMA certification, not an in-house badge.
states.promoCaption: Four real tools, mapped to an actual HFMA certification — not an in-house badge.
states.promoNarration: Each sector suite maps to a real external certification. This one ties directly to HFMA's own CRCR credential.

states.caption: Readiness Tracker — the score moves live as evidence is checked off, with its own explainability record
states.narration: This score isn't decorative. Checking off real training evidence moves the readiness bar and the overall percentage live, right here, with the explainability panel showing exactly what evidence it's reasoning over.
states.promoCaption: The readiness score moves live — with an explainability record behind it, not a black box.
states.promoNarration: Checking off real evidence moves the readiness score live, with an explainability record behind every point.

states.caption: HITL Approval — a named manager approves Sarah Kim's evidence; the decision is logged, not assumed
states.narration: Nothing deploys on a passing score alone. A named manager reviews the evidence and explicitly approves it, right here. That approval becomes an auditable record.
states.promoCaption: No deployment on score alone — a named manager approves the evidence first, on record.
states.promoNarration: Nothing deploys on a passing score alone. A named manager approves the evidence, on the record.

states.caption: Earning Path — the approval from the last step just unlocked it, live, in this same session
states.narration: That approval wasn't cosmetic. It just unlocked this candidate's Earning Path in real time — resume package, interview package, staffing submission, client deployment, all gated behind the one governance decision we made a moment ago.
states.promoCaption: That approval just unlocked the Earning Path live — governance gating the payout, not the paperwork.
states.promoNarration: That approval just unlocked the Earning Path live, in the same session — governance gating the payout.

states.caption: Deployment Center — resume, interview, and staffing packages assembled from the approved record
states.narration: Everything downstream — the resume package, the interview package, the staffing submission — is assembled from the same approved record. One governance decision feeds every package a staffing firm hands to its client.
states.promoCaption: One approved record feeds every package a staffing firm hands to its client.
states.promoNarration: One approved record feeds every package — resume, interview, staffing submission — a firm hands its client.
